title: NVIDIA Endpoint Harness Test
intent: Confirm the ChatHub-Harness can call a NVIDIA/OpenAI-compatible chat completion endpoint and write a reviewable result.

linearSteps.goal: Read the committed direction and identify what endpoint behavior should be tested.
Compose one minimal model call using the selected endpoint and model.
Verify whether the response contains assistant text in an OpenAI-compatible response shape.
Report missing secrets, endpoint failures, model failures, or parse failures clearly.
Recommend the next smallest harness fix.

constraints: Write a reviewable result even when blocked.
